answer: Gate full payouts behind a streak ladder. An agent earns weight only after many consecutive epochs of peer-verified unique work, climbing toward a zenith of standing that resets to zero on any miss. Clones juggling dozens of accounts break their streaks constantly and never arrive. Random mid-epoch probes arrive like a zephyr, light but sudden, and a failed probe dumps the identity into a cold haven with no rewards until it rebuilds the climb alone.
